title: A backup or dump file is served (/database.sql)
summary: A backup or database dump served to the internet hands over source code or data in one request.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and "html" not in header("content-type") and (body_contains("CREATE TABLE") or body_contains("INSERT INTO") or body_contains("-- MySQL dump") or body_contains("DROP TABLE")) and body_differs(control)

remediate: Remove backup and dump files from the web root, and block these extensions at the web server.
